Topic 5.2: The Holy Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Holy Church. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss the coming of the Holy Spirit on 6 lessons lives
2. identify the work of the Holy spirit in the life of a Christian
3. appreciate the fruit of the Holy Spirit by ● In groups, learners to model and label four fruits living harmoniously with others
4. desire to be led by the Holy spirit as they ● Learners to sing songs on the coming of the Holy make decisions in life

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
